//: Deno import map for Readmo Edge Functions. The shared server modules under _shared/ import the parser and sanitizer with BARE specifiers (`fast-xml-parser`, `sanitize-html`, `entities`) so that vitest (node) can import them directly from node_modules during unit tests. Deno does not resolve bare npm specifiers on its own, so this map rewrites them to `npm:` specifiers at deploy/serve time. Reference it from the CLI with `--import-map supabase/functions/import_map.json` (or via deno.json / config).
//pinning: Versions here are EXACT, not ranges, and must equal the version package-lock.json installs — import_map.test.ts fails CI otherwise. There is no deno.lock and `supabase functions deploy` resolves this map fresh on every deploy, so a range would let the Edge runtime float to a version the tests never ran (and, when it drifted below package.json, to one carrying a known advisory). Exact pins are what make 'node tests and Deno runtime parse identically' true rather than aspirational. Cost: a dependency bump must update this file too — that failing test IS the reminder, since no bot can see this file.
